## Services

- **Web Design & Development** — Landing pages, business websites, custom web apps, redesigns
- **Digital Marketing** — Social media advertising, SEO, Google Business Profile, email campaigns
- **E-commerce & Custom Features** — Online stores, M-Pesa & card payments, inventory, booking systems
- **Custom SaaS App Development** — Auth, roles, dashboards, M-Pesa payments, deployed & documented
- **Graphic Design** — Logos, brand kits, social media kits, flyers, marketing creatives
- **Custom AI Agent** — WhatsApp/site chat/email agents that qualify leads and book jobs
- **Workflow Automation** — M-Pesa to Sheets/CRM, inquiry to WhatsApp to calendar, auto-invoices
- **Business Dashboard** — Live sales, M-Pesa feed, bookings, stock on one screen
